thread:
kevin: Quick sync — SparkPlugAI (hardware partner) wants an end-to-end demo next Wed. They want LangChain + LlamaIndex flow -> our gateway -> Dedicated pool. Who owns which piece?

maya: I can own the LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter validation. Will run the sample flows and surface any API gaps. ETA EOD Tue for a smoke report.

sam: I’ll take gateway auth and SSO. Need to confirm SparkPlug’s IdP details and whether we should test with their staging certs or use a temporary dev client. Also will check Dedicated pool capacity and quota.

julia: Solutions will own the demo narrative and customer journey. I’ll draft a 10-min script and callouts for latency/cost numbers we want to show. Need the smoke report + SSO status before Wed.

chris: Marketing: hold the public announcement until after the customer signs off, but we can prep co-branded slides. Also want to align on marketplace listing timing — do we aim to list SparkPlug bundle in the cloud marketplaces or our partner catalog first? :thinking_face:

kevin: Good. Marketplace first in our partner catalog; cloud marketplace listing is a follow-up (needs legal/contract). Maya/sam — any known blockers?

maya: One thing — LlamaIndex’s vector store path needs a small tweak for our cache prefix to avoid collisions across dedicated tenants. I’ll paste the minimal change to test locally: ```python
# add tenant prefix for cache key
def cache_key(tenant_id, query):
    return f"{tenant_id}:lindex:{hash(query)}"
```

sam: Blocker: SparkPlug uses a nonstandard cert chain on staging. If they can provide a PEM bundle we can validate, otherwise I’ll spin up a proxy to terminate TLS and use our test client. Also need a short maintenance window for the Dedicated pool to push the gateway change — suggested Tue 02:00–03:00 UTC.

partners-bot: reminder — compliance checklist requires an IPA review for any co-announcement. Filing ticket: PARTNER-4782.

julia: Timeline suggestion: Tue EOD smoke report, Tue night gateway push (Sam), Wed 09:00 internal demo, Wed 11:00 partner-facing demo. If any of those slip we push by 48 hours.

kevin: Sounds good. Action items: Maya -> smoke report (owner), Sam -> gateway + SSO + maintenance window (owner), Julia -> demo script & slides (owner), Chris -> draft co-marketing assets and embargo plan (owner). I’ll coordinate with SparkPlug leadership on sign-off times.

maya: One more test to add — run LangChain tool-calling path with our streaming enabled. Quick curl to test generation endpoint: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2", "input":"summarize: test"}'
```

sam: Noted. I’ll update the runbook and add a rollback plan in case gateway change causes token routing regressions.

chris: Drafting slides now. Will post a first pass in this thread by Tue midday. :rocket: 

kevin: If anyone needs legal/contract signoff for marketplace assets ping me and I’ll loop in michelle from bizdev.

julia: uploading demo checklist to drive and will share link here shortly.

partners-bot: PARTNER-4782 created and assigned to legal-review. Ping @kevin when ready.

sam: ok, scheduling the maintenance window and will post the exact timestamp once confirmed with infra. :thumbsup:

kevin: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for blockers. If anything changes, drop a quick update here. :eyes:
